summary: The folder rework is a clean git mv with zero content change plus the four files the move falsifies. Both claims the phase rests on hold under independent probing: kc project build is green from argocd-hook/ (the dispatched gate log covers only kc project test), and the suite discovers 58 tests rather than reading green on a vacuous discovery. One advisory finding — three sibling-repo comments cite the old presync/ path and no phase owns them.
